title: Notice on Tuition Payment for Current International Students for the 2026–2027 Academic Year
review_scope: Reviewed sections I–V of this notice. Targeted official-domain search and the first official notice-list page were also inspected; this was not an exhaustive supersession check. The linked payment-instructions PDF and authenticated platform were not reviewed. Stored paraphrases exclude bank accounts, routing details and personal contact addresses. Revision is Rantau's local record revision, not an official document version.

scope.audience: Current international undergraduate, master's and doctoral students enrolling in fall 2026; not an admissions or China-wide policy.

claims.value: Use the International Student Service Platform and select ZJU Unified Identity Authentication.
claims.conditions: Online tuition payment for the notice's stated student cohort and payment period.

claims.locator: IV. Alternative Payment Method, opening paragraph
claims.conditions: Bank or wire transfer offered to students unable to pay online; include these in reference/remarks.

claims.value: Upload the bank transfer receipt to the International Student Service Platform after transferring.
claims.locator: IV. Alternative Payment Method, opening paragraph
claims.conditions: Evidence submission for the alternative transfer method; an uploaded receipt does not prove tuition posting.

claims.value: Online payers retrieve the electronic receipt through the platform; bank/wire payers request a payment receipt by emailing the listed university contact.
claims.conditions: Receipt retrieval differs by payment method; it is distinct from uploading the bank transfer receipt.

claims.locator: Sections I–V reviewed; no posting-duration guarantee found
claims.conditions: No inference from receipt submission or the payment period.

claims.locator: Sections I–V reviewed; no partial-payment rule found
Sections I–V reviewed; no top-up rule found
Sections I–V reviewed; no IDR-to-CNY provider route specified
claims.conditions: Bank/wire instructions do not establish a supported corridor, provider, fee or exchange rate.

claims.locator: Sections I–V reviewed; no public ledger-posting API specified
claims.conditions: A student platform link is not evidence of an integration API.
